{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds #-}
{-# LANGUAGE TypeApplications #-}

module Service.Vault where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.IORef
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout)
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime)
import Data.Time.Format (formatTime, defaultTimeLocale)
import Crypto.Cipher.AES (AES256)
import Crypto.Cipher.Types (cipherInit, cbcEncrypt, makeIV, BlockCipher, IV)
import Crypto.Error (CryptoFailable(..))
import Crypto.Random (getRandomBytes)
import Data.ByteArray (convert)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64

-- | Audit log entry structure
data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { aeTimestamp :: String
  , aeAction   :: String
  , aeUser     :: String
  , aeResource :: String
  , aeStatus   :: String
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Format an audit entry for structured logging
formatAuditEntry :: AuditEntry -> String
formatAuditEntry entry =
  "[" ++ aeTimestamp entry ++ "] " ++
  "action=" ++ aeAction entry ++ " " ++
  "user=" ++ aeUser entry ++ " " ++
  "resource=" ++ aeResource entry ++ " " ++
  "status=" ++ aeStatus entry

-- | Sanitize a field value for safe logging
-- Removes control characters and ensures single-line output
sanitizeField :: T.Text -> T.Text
sanitizeField = T.filter (\c -> c /= '\n' && c /= '\r' && c /= '\t')

-- | Normalize unicode to prevent homoglyph-based log confusion
normalizeForLog :: T.Text -> T.Text
normalizeForLog t = T.map replaceConfusable t
  where
    replaceConfusable c
      | c == '\x200B' = ' '  -- zero-width space
      | c == '\x00AD' = '-'  -- soft hyphen
      | c == '\xFEFF' = ' '  -- BOM
      | otherwise     = c

-- | Encrypt a secret value using AES-256-CBC for storage.
-- A fresh random IV is generated per invocation and prepended to the
-- ciphertext so that identical plaintexts do not produce identical output.
encryptSecret :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String BS.ByteString)
encryptSecret key plaintext =
  case cipherInit @AES256 key of
    CryptoFailed e  -> return $ Left (show e)
    CryptoPassed cipher -> do
      ivBytes <- getRandomBytes 16 :: IO BS.ByteString
      case makeIV ivBytes :: Maybe (IV AES256) of
        Nothing -> return $ Left "Failed to generate IV"
        Just iv ->
          let padded = pkcs7Pad 16 plaintext
              ciphertext = cbcEncrypt cipher iv padded
          in return $ Right (BS.append ivBytes ciphertext)

-- | PKCS7 padding
pkcs7Pad :: Int -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
pkcs7Pad blockSize bs =
  let padLen = blockSize - (BS.length bs `mod` blockSize)
      padding = BS.replicate padLen (fromIntegral padLen)
  in BS.append bs padding

-- | The gRPC service handler for storing secrets
data VaultRequest = VaultRequest
  { vrUser     :: T.Text
  , vrResource :: T.Text
  , vrSecret   :: BS.ByteString
  , vrMetadata :: [(T.Text, T.Text)]
  }

data VaultResponse = VaultResponse
  { vrSuccess :: Bool
  , vrMessage :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Process metadata fields and build context string for logging
buildMetadataContext :: [(T.Text, T.Text)] -> String
buildMetadataContext [] = ""
buildMetadataContext pairs =
  let formatted = map formatPair pairs
  in " metadata={" ++ unwords (map T.unpack formatted) ++ "}"
  where
    -- Apply sanitization to both keys and values
    formatPair (k, v) =
      let safeKey = sanitizeField k
          -- Values are base64 encoded in the log output
          -- to prevent any injection through metadata values
          encodedVal = TE.decodeUtf8 $ B64.encode (TE.encodeUtf8 v)
      in T.concat [safeKey, T.pack "=", encodedVal]

-- | Main handler for vault store requests
handleStoreSecret :: IORef [(String, BS.ByteString)] -> BS.ByteString -> VaultRequest -> IO VaultResponse
handleStoreSecret storeRef encKey req = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let timestamp = formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z" now

  -- Sanitize user and resource for the primary audit fields
  let safeUser = T.unpack $ sanitizeField $ normalizeForLog $ vrUser req
  let safeResource = T.unpack $ sanitizeField $ normalizeForLog $ vrResource req

  -- Build metadata context for extended logging
  let metaCtx = buildMetadataContext (vrMetadata req)

  encResult <- encryptSecret encKey (vrSecret req)
  case encResult of
    Left err -> do
      let entry = AuditEntry timestamp "STORE" safeUser safeResource "FAILED"
      putStrLn $ formatAuditEntry entry ++ metaCtx
      hFlush stdout
      return $ VaultResponse False (T.pack $ "Encryption failed: " ++ err)

    Right ciphertext -> do
      modifyIORef storeRef ((safeResource, ciphertext) :)
      let entry = AuditEntry timestamp "STORE" safeUser safeResource "SUCCESS"
      putStrLn $ formatAuditEntry entry ++ metaCtx
      hFlush stdout
      return $ VaultResponse True "Secret stored successfully"

-- | Health check handler that logs access
handleHealthCheck :: T.Text -> IO VaultResponse
handleHealthCheck clientId = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let timestamp = formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z" now
  let safeId = T.unpack $ sanitizeField $ normalizeForLog clientId
  putStrLn $ "[" ++ timestamp ++ "] action=HEALTH_CHECK client=" ++ safeId ++ " status=OK"
  hFlush stdout
  return $ VaultResponse True "OK"
